exposure: Panton-Valentine Leukocidin-positive methicillin-sensitive Staphylococcus aureus (PVL-MSSA) infection
cohort: Neonates admitted to a neonatal unit in West London
finding: An outbreak of PVL-MSSA infection in a neonatal unit was associated with lower gestational age, longer length of stay, and birth by caesarean section.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was significantly associated with PVL-MSSA infection (88% of cases vs. less than half of controls, P = 0.002).
gest_age: Mean gestational age of cases: 31.7 weeks, controls: 35.6 weeks
